results.title: Intersection
results.overview: Amadeus loses his beloved daughter. A personal tragedy coincides with a job loss. Desperate, takes part in the secret project and test the unknown "Intersection" technology. He soon realizes that he was chosen for this task not by chance.

results.title: Still, We Smile
results.overview: After the military coup in 2021, Kyaw Kyaw and his friends could no longer safely live in the city, so they took refuge with the armed resistance force and decided to continue their revolutionary journey to the very end.

results.title: Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger VS King-Ohger
results.original_title: 爆上戦隊ブンブンジャーVSキングオージャー
results.overview: Nicola, who has ascended to the throne as the queen of Planet Trickle, has decided to form an alliance with Planet Chikyu. Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger has been invited to act as witnesses. However, a remnant of the Hashiriyan named Manhole Grumer appears and steals the jewel that's been passed down in the Trickle royal family from Nicola! Furthermore, Minongan, one of Dagded's five jesters appears and steals the Ohgercalibur ZERO, which was prepared for the alliance ceremony! The Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger rushes to the scene and fights alongside the Boonboomger, but the warriors are separated by Manhole Grumer's mysterious power. Taiya and the others were scattered across the stars, each take action to escape from this dire situation. Soon, a dangerous heartbeat begins to resonate from deep underground. As a powerful evil awakens, will the two great Super Sentai be able to come together again fight together?! The battle for the three planets begins now!!

results.title: John Neumeier: The Nutcracker  - Hamburg Ballet
results.original_title: John Neumeier: The Nutcracker Hamburg Ballet
results.overview: Created in 1971, John Neumeier's ballet set to Tchaikovsky's music is now a classic performed all over the world. In his reinterpretation of The Nutcracker, the American choreographer transposes young Marie's initiation into the world of dance under the tutelage of ballet master Drosselmeier.

results.title: A Fábrica de Sonhos
results.overview: Eleutério and Rafaela's marriage is tested when she wins a contest to meet Sydartha, a soap opera heartthrob. The romantic teacher confuses fiction and reality when she meets her idol.

results.title: The Children are afraid
results.overview: Every year, Mylène, a teacher, faces challenges in her work. This year, it's little Axelle and her mother who are putting her through the wringer. Patience, firmness, and trust will guide the teacher in helping both the child and her mother feel secure - each of them having a heart much softer than they let on at first glance.

results.title: Kampung Keramat
results.overview: Erlan Mario and Widi Kania decided to return to their grandfather's village after Maya suffered a fatal accident that left her paralyzed and frequently experiencing magical occurrences. Jabo came to pick up his three grandchildren along with Ruth to take them back to the village for Maya's healing. Jabo believed that Maya's illness was not an ordinary one, but a mystical disease that could only be cured by a shaman in a deserted village called Kampung Bekandang. Maya's healing by the shaman, however, brought about disaster and terror, threatening the lives of their family.

results.title: Healer
results.overview: A young woman attends a healer’s book-signing event with her sick mom.

results.title: Quince Candles
results.overview: A plucky 14 year old runs aimlessly through a dark vineyard as she struggles to break free from her rocky home life, social pressure, and the shooting she's just witnessed. Based on a true story.

results.title: Four Down
results.overview: Chronicles Nick Schuyler's dramatic rescue by the US Coast Guard 43 hours after a boating accident in the Gulf of Mexico that took the lives of NFL players Marquis Cooper, Corey Smith, and Schulyer's best friend, Will Bleakley.

results.title: Umjolo: There Is No Cure
results.overview: After losing her title for publicly exposing a scandal, a former pageant queen works on a tell-all book — all while her love life remains unwritten.

results.title: August so Tragic and Tender
results.overview: Eryka is a documentary filmmaker who has just returned from filming at the Saharawi refugee camps in Africa. Arriving on the coast in southern Spain to meet her boyfriend, Marc, she discovers he has vanished when he was hang-gliding over the ocean. Thinking the Coast Guard search is ineffective, she begins her own search with the help of Marc’s best friend, David.

results.title: Majhi Prarthana
results.overview: Set in British-era rural Maharashtra, Majhi Prarthana – Akalpaniya Prem Katha is a heart-wrenching tale of unimaginable love. Golya and Prarthana’s love blooms like a wildflower amidst thorns and they find solace in each other’s hearts, shining brighter than the stars. But as their love deepens, a dark force rises —an unrelenting shadow of power and betrayal determined to crush their dreams. Will their love withstand the storm and carve its name into history, or will it be lost in the abyss of fate?

results.title: Mond Appétit
results.overview: Mond Appétit is the newest film of director Sjoerd de Bont

results.title: El Pornitólgo
results.overview: On the edge of the forest and of desire, an ornithologist ventures deep into Collserola to observe birds in the wild. But the songs that guide him do not always come from the sky, and his research takes an unexpected turn when the animals’ rituals begin to reflect other forms of presence and affection among bodies hidden among the trees.

results.title: Yeah Nah
results.overview: Nellie and Eleanor both live with Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD), navigating the weight of daily anxiety, finding connection in a most unexpected way.

results.title: BUSTED!
results.overview: Based on a true story, Sarah, a research scientist at a New York City sperm bank moonlighting as a comedian, faces her hospital’s HR department after they discover a video of her stand-up where she divulges a little too much about her day job.

results.title: The Brooklyn Butcher
results.overview: As the city cowers in fear of a deranged serial killer, the residents of one Brooklyn apartment building learn new meanings of the word fear as they each encounter their own personal horrors.

results.title: The Offing
results.overview: Neviah, a tormented recluse, and Freya, an enigmatic stranger, embark on a scenic road trip that spirals into chaos. Struggling to outrun the past, their friendship is tested at every turn, with all roads leading to a shocking revelation.

results.title: Lucidity
results.overview: A man starts having bizarre dreams, changing his view of recent events in his life.
